threat_summary: A phishing campaign sends archive files containing LNK shortcuts that execute PowerShell and retrieve remote content.
hunt_checklist: Find PowerShell launched from LNK or explorer context.
Check remote URL contacted by PowerShell.
correlation_logic: Correlate behavior on the same host/user within a 24-hour window unless the report specifies a narrower time range.
escalation_condition: Escalate when LNK execution leads to PowerShell network activity.
